topic: Someone finds their partner's bucket list
text: I stumbled upon Alex's journal the other day, tucked away on a high shelf in our closet. Flipping through the pages, my eyes fell on a list, clearly marked as a bucket list. Each item, from 'Learn to speak Italian' to 'Watch the sunrise over the Alps,' painted a picture of dreams I hadn’t known Alex harbored. I felt a weight in my chest, a mix of excitement for them and a gnawing discomfort for invading this private space. I carefully placed the journal back, deciding to ask Alex about it over dinner, framing it as a discovery that sparked curiosity rather than an intrusion. I want to celebrate this side of Alex, the one full of hidden wishes and adventures waiting to unfold.
